A '''criminal organization''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]], the [[agricultural expert]] [[Tayvor Mandirly]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Raxis]] and [[Nolid]], two members of that organization.
